title: Before You Pool JetBlue Points, Choose Who Can Spend Them
caption:
Pool JetBlue points only with people you trust to spend them.

Per JetBlue’s FAQ, the pool leader and designated authorized redeemers can spend pooled points without other members’ permission. You can still redeem your individual unused balance and take your remaining unused points when you leave. Official FAQ: https://www.jetblue.com/help/points-pooling

The catch: agreeing to ask first doesn’t create an approval requirement. The group chat is not a security setting. Skip pooling if everyone needs an enforceable veto.

Full article: https://practicalrewards.com/blog/before-you-pool-jetblue-points-choose-who-can-spend-them-967c55.html

Before joining, discuss the intended trip, who may redeem, and when everyone expects to be consulted.
